name: Kuliko AI
description:
AI made answers easy. Kuliko helps you stay ready.

Connect your Kuliko study library to instantly transform your notes, PDFs, slides, and documents into flashcards, quizzes, summaries, and mind maps that help you truly understand what you're learning—not just memorize it.

Built on proven learning science like spaced repetition and active recall, Kuliko helps you prepare with confidence for exams, interviews, presentations, certifications, and the moments that matter most.

Whether you're reviewing a single chapter or mastering an entire course, Kuliko adapts to your learning, tracks your progress, and helps you focus on what you need to practice next.

Everything stays connected to your Kuliko account, so your subjects, study materials, and progress are always available wherever you learn.
    - Stay Ready with Kuliko
    - Generate flashcards, quizzes, summaries, and mind maps from your own notes
    - Study with spaced repetition and active recall
    - Build real understanding instead of memorizing answers
    - Organize every subject in one study library
    - Prepare for exams, interviews, presentations, and more
    - Learn with confidence using AI designed for mastery—not shortcuts

Finding an answer isn't the same as being ready.

Stay Ready.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kuliko AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kuliko AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.kuliko.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kuliko AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kuliko AI lists 36 MCP tools, including add_share_group_member, create_share_group, create_subject, create_text_document, generate_learning_resources, get_document, get_document_text, get_flashcard_due_counts, get_quiz_questions, get_quiz_results, get_quiz_status, and get_share_group.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kuliko AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kuliko AI in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.

_published_faq.name: Does Kuliko AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kuliko AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kuliko AI is developed by Kuliko Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
